questions.question: The given table shows employees working in various departments of company ABC Ltd., over several years. Study the table and answer the question that follows. 						Departments/			Years			Research			Marketing			Production			Account			Finance							2017			45			50			50			45			50							2018			40			45			75			60			45							2019			55			55			85			55			40							2020			60			60			115			70			55							2021			65			65			130			40			60							2022			45			70			150			75			65			What is the total number of employees in company ABC Ltd., in the year 2020?
Arrange the following ratios in ascending order.3 : 20, 6 : 5, 12 : 3, 26 : 115238
An agent sells a hot pot having the marked price as ₹7,650 at a discount of 26 percent. What is the selling price (in ₹) of the hot pot?
In a mixture of 100 litres, the ratio of milk to water is 4 : 1. If this ratio is to be 1 : 4, find the quantity of water to be further added.
If an item marked at ₹1,100 is sold for ₹330, what is the discount percentage?
In what time (in years) will ₹5,000 fetch an interest of ₹800 at 8% per year simple interest?

A trader offers a discount of 29% on the marked price of an article. How much percentage above the cost price should he mark the article to make a profit of 29%?(Give your answer rounded off to 2 decimal places.)
A cosmetic product is available at a discount of 11% on its marked price. If the shopkeeper charges ₹1,602, what is its marked price?
P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 8 hours. If P alone can fill the same amount of water in 40 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill the same amount of water?

(Give your answer correct up to two decimal places.)
A 501-m long train passes through a 149-m long tunnel in 26 seconds. Find the speed of the train.
The height of a cylinder, open at the top, is 97 cm and its internal diameter is 13 cm. What is its internal surface area (in cm2, correct to one decimal place)? (Take π = 22/7)

₹11,535 is divided among A, B, and C in such a way that if ₹64, ₹32, and ₹25 are deducted from their respective shares, they have money in the ratio 6 : 2 : 5. Find the difference between B’s and C’s shares.
The average of 13 numbers is 13. If each number is multiplied by 9, then what will the new average be?
The average of first 13 multiples of 12 is:
The sides of a triangle are 24 cm, 45 cm and 51 cm. What is its area? (in cm2 )

In a library, the ratio of the number of story books to that of non-story books was 4 : 1, and total number of story books was 1236. When some more story books were bought, the ratio became 13 : 1. Find the number of story books bought.
A family's monthly income is ₹72,000. They spend 25% on rent, 15% on groceries, 22% on education and 8% on other expenses. They save the remaining amount. Calculate their monthly savings.
